title: Extract Engram MCP revocation lifecycle into an owning module
outcome: The reviewed revocation subsystem is split across turn_lifecycle.rs types and locked helpers, session_crud.rs off-lock orchestration, and session_lifecycle.rs Stop-failure transfer. Create src/engram_mcp_revocation.rs with the project provenance header; move the subsystem types, claim/rollback/transfer helpers, and teardown orchestration there while leaving only thin CRUD/Stop call sites and the terminal record mutation in turn_lifecycle.rs. Preserve fence ownership, callback replay, and all lifecycle behavior as a pure structural extraction.
acceptance: One module owns and documents the revocation protocol; session_crud.rs no longer hosts runtime-death orchestration; existing runtime-stop ownership and revocation tests remain behaviorally unchanged; required Rust gates pass.
